```python
# =================================================================
# Окно: позиция + «закрыть в трей»
# =================================================================

class FakeWindow:
    """Заглушка page.window: помним то, что Flet реально меняет."""

    def __init__(self, left=10, top=20):
        self.left = left
        self.top = top
        self.visible = True
        self.minimized = False
        self.prevent_close = False
        self.closed = False
        self.on_event = None

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True


class FakePage:
    """Заглушка ft.Page для событий окна."""

    def __init__(self, left=10, top=20):
        self.window = FakeWindow(left, top)
        self.updates = 0

    def update(self):
        self.updates += 1


def win_event(kind, page=None):
    """Фейковое событие окна Flet."""
    return SimpleNamespace(type=kind, page=page)


def test_window_moved_saves_position(gui, cfg):
    """Позиция окна сохраняется (gui_x/gui_y), как было и раньше."""
    gui._page = FakePage(left=100, top=200)

    gui._on_window_event(win_event(ft.WindowEventType.MOVED))

    assert cfg["gui_x"] == 100
    assert cfg["gui_y"] == 200


def test_window_close_hides_to_tray(gui):
    """Крестик при живом трее прячет окно, а не убивает Феникса."""
    page = FakePage()
    gui._page = page
    gui.tray_active = True

    gui._on_window_event(win_event(ft.WindowEventType.CLOSE, page))

    assert page.window.prevent_close is True
    assert page.window.visible is False
    assert page.updates == 1


def test_window_close_without_tray_exits(gui):
    """Без трея крестик закрывает окно штатно (Flet завершит сессию)."""
    page = FakePage()
    gui._page = page
    gui.tray_active = False

    gui._on_window_event(win_event(ft.WindowEventType.CLOSE, page))

    assert page.window.prevent_close is False
    assert page.window.visible is True


def test_quit_closes_window(gui):
    """«Выход» из трея закрывает окно — иначе процесс остаётся жить."""
    page = FakePage()
    gui._page = page
    page.window.prevent_close = True

    gui.quit()

    assert page.window.prevent_close is False
    assert page.window.closed is True


def test_quit_without_page_is_safe(gui):
    """GUI ещё не поднялся — quit() не падает."""
    gui._page = None

    gui.quit()


def test_set_tray_active_toggles_prevent_close(gui):
    """Трей включили на лету — окно больше не закрывается крестиком."""
    page = FakePage()

    assert page.window.prevent_close is True

    gui.set_tray_active(False)

    assert page.window.prevent_close is False

def test_show_window_makes_window_visible(gui):
    """Пункт трея «Открыть окно» реально возвращает окно на экран."""
```

### `tests/test_intents.py`

```python
"""Автотест Феникса без микрофона. ... [25 строк]"""

import argparse
import logging
import sys
import time
from contextlib import ExitStack, contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

# Принудительно UTF-8 для stdout/stderr — иначе на CI (Windows, cp1252)
# падает UnicodeEncodeError при печати русских букв.
if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

# Скрипт лежит в tests/, а корень проекта — на уровень выше.
# BASE_DIR = корень нужен, чтобы лог остался в logs/ проекта (как в docs),
# а sys.path — чтобы `python tests/test_intents.py` видел пакет jarvis
# (иначе sys.path[0] = tests/ и `import jarvis` падает).
BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(BASE_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

LOGS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "logs"
LOGS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
LOG_FILE = LOGS_DIR / "test_intents.log"

log = logging.getLogger("jarvis.test")
log.setLevel(logging.INFO)

_fmt = logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")


def setup_logging() -> None:
    """Вешает хендлеры лениво — только при реальном запуске скрипта. ... [4 строк]"""
    if log.handlers:
        return
    fh = logging.FileHandler(LOG_FILE, mode="w", encoding="utf-8")
    fh.setFormatter(_fmt)
    log.addHandler(fh)
    ch = logging.StreamHandler()
    ch.setFormatter(_fmt)
    log.addHandler(ch)


# =================================================================
# Setup / teardown для тестов, которым нужно особое окружение.
# Возвращают (setup, teardown), либо None.
#
# ВАЖНО: работаем с config._data напрямую (в памяти), НЕ через config.set().
# Иначе пароль пользователя уйдёт на диск — если тест упадёт между
# setup и teardown, пароль потеряется.
# =================================================================

def _no_password_setup(handler):
    """Временно выставить danger_password = "" в памяти."""
    handler._saved_password = handler.config._data.get("danger_password", "")
    handler.config._data["danger_password"] = ""


def _no_password_teardown(handler):
    """Вернуть пароль как было — в памяти, без записи на диск."""
    saved = getattr(handler, "_saved_password", "")
    handler.config._data["danger_password"] = saved
    handler._saved_password = ""


def _with_password_setup(handler):
    """Временно выставить danger_password = 'test_password_123' в памяти."""
    handler._saved_password = handler.config._data.get("danger_password", "")
    handler.config._data["danger_password"] = "test_password_123"


def _add_note_setup(handler):
    """Заводит факт, ключ которого не совпадает со словами команды. ... [4 строк]"""
    from jarvis import learning
    learning.add_fact("тестовая заметка", "проверка 12345")


def _add_note_teardown(handler):
    """Если команда не сработала — факт не должен остаться в профиле."""
    from jarvis import learning
    learning.forget_fact("тестовая заметка")


def _correction_setup(handler):
    """Запоминает коррекции до теста — teardown уберёт только новые."""
    from jarvis import learning
    handler._corrections_before = dict(learning.all_corrections())


def _correction_teardown(handler):
    """Убирает коррекции, созданные тестом. ... [5 строк]"""
    from jarvis import learning
    before = getattr(handler, "_corrections_before", {})
    for wrong in list(learning.all_corrections()):
        if wrong not in before:
            learning.forget_correction(wrong)


# teardown — тот же, что у _no_password_teardown


# (name, cmd, expected, requires_llm, requires_network, hooks)
# hooks: None или (setup_fn, teardown_fn).
TESTS = [
    # === Режимы (без LLM, без сети) ===
    ("mode_set_llm",        "режим ии",                   ["Режим", "ИИ"],          False, False, None),
    ("mode_query",          "какой режим",                ["Сейчас режим"],         False, False, None),
    ("mode_set_combo",      "обычный режим",              ["комбинированный"],      False, False, None),
    ("mode_set_commands",   "режим команды",              ["только команды"],       False, False, None),
    ("mode_restore",        "обычный режим",              ["комбинированный"],      False, False, None),

    # === Голоса (быстрые правила, без LLM) ===
    ("voice_list",          "какой голос",                ["голос"],                False, False, None),

class Result:
    def __init__(self, name, cmd, reply_text, expected, elapsed):
        self.name = name
        self.cmd = cmd
        self.reply_text = reply_text
        self.expected = expected
        self.elapsed = elapsed
        # error инициализируем ДО _check(): иначе тест с исключением
        # не отличить от обычного, а _check() читает self.error.
        self.error = None
        self.passed = self._check()

    def _check(self):
        # Тест с исключением не может быть «пройден», даже если ожиданий нет.
        # Иначе small_talk_how с expected=[] молча съедал TypeError
        # из finalize_stream и харнес рапортовал зелёный.
        if self.error is not None:
            return False
        if not self.reply_text:
            return False
        if not self.expected:
            return True
        text = str(self.reply_text).lower()
        return any(e.lower() in text for e in self.expected)

    def __str__(self):
        mark = "OK  " if self.passed else "FAIL"
        return f"[{mark}] {self.name:24s} ({self.elapsed:5.2f} с) «{self.cmd}»"


def build_handler(use_llm=False, reset_profile=True):
    """Собирает IntentHandler. ... [5 строк]"""
    from jarvis.config import load_config
    from jarvis.apps import build_apps
    from jarvis.intents import IntentHandler

    log.info("Загрузка конфига...")
    config = load_config(BASE_DIR)

    # В тестах — только Piper. Silero требует torch, грузит модель 2-3 сек,
    # а голоса у него другие (aidar/baya/...). Тесты ожидают Piper-голоса
    # (ruslan, irina, dmitri, denis).
    if config.get("tts_backend", "auto") != "piper":
        log.info("Тесты: tts_backend принудительно → piper")
        config._data["tts_backend"] = "piper"

    if reset_profile:
        from jarvis import profile
        if profile.forget("default_city"):
            log.info("Профиль: default_city сброшен для чистого прогона")
        else:
            log.info("Профиль: default_city уже отсутствовал")

    brain = None
    if use_llm:
        from jarvis.brain import Brain
        model = config.get("llm_model", "qwen2.5:7b-instruct")
        url = config.get("ollama_url", "http://127.0.0.1:11434")
        log.info("Инициализация LLM: %s", model)
        brain = Brain(model, url)
        if not brain.available:
            log.warning("LLM недоступна — работаем только с правилами")
            brain = None
        else:
            log.info("Ждём прогрева LLM (10 с)...")
            time.sleep(10)

    log.info("Сборка IntentHandler...")
    return IntentHandler(config, build_apps(config), brain)


# =================================================================
# Тесты не должны открывать настоящий браузер
# =================================================================
# «открой ютуб» — проверка разбора команды, а не повод открыть вкладку.
# Локально каждый прогон добавлял вкладку (а прогонов много), в CI браузера
# нет вовсе. Подменяем только действия-открывашки: разбор фразы, ответ и
# проверка ожиданий остаются настоящими.

_OPEN_ACTIONS = ("open_url", "open_browser", "open_search", "open_site_lucky")


@contextmanager
def no_real_browser():
    """Открытие сайтов/браузера → заглушка «открыл» (True)."""
    from unittest.mock import patch

    from jarvis import actions

    with ExitStack() as stack:
        for name in _OPEN_ACTIONS:
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(actions, name, return_value=True))
        yield


def reset_handler_state(handler):
    """Сбрасывает stateful-состояние между тестами. ... [7 строк]"""
    handler._pending_password = None
    handler._reset_requested = False


def run_one(handler, speaker, name, cmd, expected, hooks=None):
    log.info("─" * 70)
    log.info("ТЕСТ: %s | команда: %r", name, cmd)

    # Чистое состояние перед каждым тестом
    reset_handler_state(handler)

    setup, teardown = hooks if hooks else (None, None)
    if setup:
        try:
            setup(handler)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("setup не удался для %s", name)

    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        reply = handler.handle(cmd)
        if reply.is_stream:
            reply_text = "".join(reply.stream)
            handler.finalize_stream(reply_text)
        else:
            reply_text = reply.text
    except Exception as e:
        log.exception("Исключение в тесте %s", name)
        r = Result(name, cmd, f"<EXCEPTION: {e}>", expected, time.time() - t0)
        r.error = str(e)
        if teardown:
            try:
                teardown(handler)
            except Exception:
                log.exception("teardown не удался для %s", name)
        return r

    elapsed = time.time() - t0

    if teardown:
        try:
            teardown(handler)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("teardown не удался для %s", name)

    if speaker is not None and reply_text:
        try:
            speaker.speak(reply_text)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("Ошибка озвучки")

    r = Result(name, cmd, reply_text, expected, elapsed)
    log.info("Ответ: %s", str(reply_text)[:200])
    log.info("Результат: %s", "OK" if r.passed else f"FAIL (ожидалось: {expected})")
    return r


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Автотест Феникса")
    parser.add_argument("--llm", action="store_true",
                        help="Использовать LLM (нужна Ollama)")
    parser.add_argument("--voice", action="store_true",
                        help="Озвучивать ответы")
    parser.add_argument("--network", action="store_true",
                        help="Запускать тесты, требующие сеть (погода, курс)")
    parser.add_argument("--real-browser", action="store_true",
                        help="Открывать сайты по-настоящему (по умолчанию — заглушка)")
    parser.add_argument("-k", "--filter",
                        help="Фильтр по имени теста")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    setup_logging()

    log.info("=" * 70)
    log.info("АВТОТЕСТ ФЕНИКСА")
    log.info("LLM: %s | Сеть: %s | Озвучка: %s | Браузер: %s",
             "вкл" if args.llm else "выкл",
             "вкл" if args.network else "выкл",
             "вкл" if args.voice else "выкл",
             "настоящий" if args.real_browser else "заглушка")
    log.info("Лог: %s", LOG_FILE)
    log.info("=" * 70)

    handler = build_handler(use_llm=args.llm)

    speaker = None
    if args.voice:
        try:
            from jarvis.tts import Speaker
            speaker = Speaker(handler.config)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("Speaker не завёлся — без озвучки")

    tests = TESTS
    if args.filter:
        f = args.filter.lower()
        tests = [t for t in tests if f in t[0].lower()]
        log.info("Фильтр %r: %d тестов", args.filter, len(tests))

    results = []
    skipped = []
    t_start = time.time()
    # Сайты по умолчанию не открываем по-настоящему — иначе тесты плодят
    # вкладки в браузере (см. no_real_browser). Нужен настоящий — --real-browser.
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        if not args.real_browser:
            stack.enter_context(no_real_browser())
        for entry in tests:
            # entry — 6 полей: (name, cmd, expected, requires_llm, requires_network, hooks)
            name, cmd, expected, requires_llm, requires_network, hooks = entry
            if requires_llm and not args.llm:
                log.info("ПРОПУСК %s (требует --llm)", name)
                skipped.append(f"{name} (--llm)")
                continue
            if requires_network and not args.network:
                log.info("ПРОПУСК %s (требует --network)", name)
                skipped.append(f"{name} (--network)")
                continue
            r = run_one(handler, speaker, name, cmd, expected, hooks)
            results.append(r)

    total = time.time() - t_start
    passed = [r for r in results if r.passed]
    failed = [r for r in results if not r.passed]

    log.info("")
    log.info("=" * 70)
    log.info("ИТОГ: %d / %d пройдено за %.1f с", len(passed), len(results), total)
    if skipped:
        log.info("Пропущено: %d — %s", len(skipped), ", ".join(skipped))
    log.info("=" * 70)

    for r in results:
        log.info(str(r))

    if failed:
        log.info("")
        log.info("ПРОВАЛЫ:")
        for r in failed:
            log.info("  %s", r.name)
            log.info("    команда: %r", r.cmd)
            log.info("    ответ:   %s", str(r.reply_text)[:200])
            log.info("    ждали:   %s", r.expected)
            if r.error:
                log.info("    ошибка:  %s", r.error)

    log.info("")
    log.info("Полный лог: %s", LOG_FILE)
    sys.exit(0 if not failed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""config → живое ядро: подписчик make_config_listener. ... [19 строк]"""

import importlib.util

import pytest

missing = [m for m in ("vosk", "sounddevice", "flet")
           if importlib.util.find_spec(m) is None]
if missing:
    pytest.skip(f"нет {', '.join(missing)} — тест пропущен",
                allow_module_level=True)

from jarvis import vectormem  # noqa: E402
from jarvis.main import make_config_listener  # noqa: E402


class Spy:
    """Заглушка компонента: помнит, какие методы и с чем вызывали."""

    def __init__(self, name="spy"):
        self.name = name
        self.calls = []

    def __getattr__(self, item):
        def _rec(*args, **kwargs):
            self.calls.append((item, args))
            return None

        return _rec

    def called(self, method):
        return [args for name, args in self.calls if name == method]


class FakeJarvis:
    def __init__(self):
        self.barge_enabled = True
        self._wake_word_required = True


@pytest.fixture()
def wiring():
    """Собирает подписчик + заглушки и отдаёт их одним кортежем."""
    jarvis = FakeJarvis()
    listener = Spy("listener")
    speaker = Spy("speaker")
    handler = Spy("handler")
    callback = make_config_listener(jarvis, None, listener, speaker, handler)
    return jarvis, listener, speaker, handler, callback


# =================================================================
# VAD — живое применение
# =================================================================

def test_vad_threshold_reloads_vad(wiring):
    _, listener, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("vad_threshold", 0.2)
    assert listener.called("reload_vad") == [()]


def test_vad_adaptive_reloads_vad(wiring):
    _, listener, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("vad_adaptive", False)
    assert listener.called("reload_vad") == [()]


def test_vad_hangover_reloads_vad(wiring):
    _, listener, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("vad_hangover_ms", 500)
    assert listener.called("reload_vad") == [()]


def test_vad_auto_download_reloads_vad(wiring):
    """Чекбокс «качать модель VAD» пересоздаёт VAD (модель читается там)."""
    _, listener, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("vad_auto_download", False)
    assert listener.called("reload_vad") == [()]


def test_vad_enabled_toggles_vad(wiring):
    _, listener, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("vad_enabled", False)
    assert listener.called("set_vad_enabled") == [(False,)]


# =================================================================
# Трей (иконку поднимает/снимает main._apply_tray)
# =================================================================

def test_tray_enabled_calls_apply_tray():
    """Чекбокс «Иконка в трее» дёргает подъём/снятие иконки."""
    calls = []
    callback = make_config_listener(FakeJarvis(), None, Spy(), Spy(), Spy(),
                                    apply_tray=calls.append)

    callback("tray_enabled", True)
    callback("tray_enabled", False)

    assert calls == [True, False]


def test_tray_enabled_without_handler_is_safe(wiring):
    """Без apply_tray ключ просто игнорируется (тесты, headless-режим)."""
    *_, callback = wiring
    callback("tray_enabled", True)


def test_input_device_switches_microphone(wiring):
    _, listener, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("input_device", "USB Headset")
    assert listener.called("set_input_device") == [("USB Headset",)]


# =================================================================
# Остальные ключи
# =================================================================

def test_wake_word_required_flag(wiring):
    jarvis, _, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("wake_word_required", False)
    assert jarvis._wake_word_required is False


def test_barge_enabled_both_sides(wiring):
    jarvis, listener, _, _, callback = wiring
    callback("barge_enabled", False)
    assert jarvis.barge_enabled is False
    assert listener.barge_enabled is False


def test_tts_backend_switches_speaker(wiring):
    _, _, speaker, _, callback = wiring
    callback("tts_backend", "piper")
    assert speaker.called("switch_backend") == [("piper",)]


def test_tts_voice_and_rate(wiring):
    _, _, speaker, _, callback = wiring
    callback("tts_voice", "irina")
    callback("voice_rate", 1.5)
    assert speaker.called("set_voice") == [("irina",)]
    assert speaker.called("set_rate") == [(1.5,)]


def test_mode_goes_to_handler(wiring):
    _, _, _, handler, callback = wiring
    callback("mode", "llm")
    assert handler.mode == "llm"


def test_unknown_key_is_ignored(wiring):
    _, listener, speaker, _, callback = wiring
    callback("совсем_не_тот_ключ", 1)
    assert listener.calls == []
    assert speaker.calls == []


def test_memory_rag_reaches_vectormem(wiring, monkeypatch):
    """Галочка векторной памяти применяется сразу, без перезапуска."""
    _, _, _, _, callback = wiring
    seen = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(vectormem, "on_config_change",
                        lambda key, value: seen.append((key, value)))

    callback("memory_rag_enabled", True)
    callback("memory_rag_model", "bge-m3")

    assert seen == [("memory_rag_enabled", True), ("memory_rag_model", "bge-m3")]


def test_missing_listener_is_safe(wiring):
    """listener=None (GUI без микрофона) — подписчик не падает."""
    jarvis, _, speaker, handler, _ = wiring
    callback = make_config_listener(jarvis, None, None, speaker, handler)

    callback("vad_enabled", False)
    callback("vad_threshold", 0.3)
    callback("vad_hangover_ms", 1000)
    callback("input_device", "нет такого")
    callback("barge_enabled", False)

    assert jarvis.barge_enabled is False
```

```python
"""Personalization should serve a question, not choose its topic."""

from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from jarvis.memory_context import select_memory
from jarvis import learning, profile, vectormem
from jarvis.observer import DialogObserver

PROFILE = {"name": "Алексей", "default_city": "Нижний Новгород"}
FACTS = {"любимая игра": "Дота", "любимый фильм": "Матрица", "работа": "разработчик"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "query",
    [
        None,
        "",
        "Расскажи что-нибудь",
        "Расскажи мне что-нибудь",
        "Расскажи что-нибудь интересное",
        "Что нового?",
        "Сколько будет два плюс два?",
        "Я не понял",
        "Мне непонятно",
        "Какие есть города в России?",
    ],
)
def test_no_unsolicited_personalization(query):
    s = select_memory(query, PROFILE, FACTS)
    assert not s.profile and not s.facts


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "query,key",
    [
        ("Как меня зовут?", "name"),
        ("Какое у меня имя?", "name"),
        ("В каком городе я живу?", "default_city"),
        ("Что есть рядом со мной?", "default_city"),
    ],
)
def test_profile_is_scoped(query, key):
    assert select_memory(query, PROFILE, FACTS).profile == {key: PROFILE[key]}


def test_recommendations_do_not_leak_unrelated_preferences():
    s = select_memory("Посоветуй мне фильм", PROFILE, FACTS)
    assert s.facts == {"любимый фильм": "Матрица"}
    assert not s.profile


def test_explicit_memory_overview_is_bounded():
    facts = {f"факт {i}": f"значение {i}" for i in range(100)}
    s = select_memory("Что ты запомнил обо мне?", PROFILE, facts)
    assert s.profile == PROFILE
    assert len(s.facts) == 5
    assert len(facts) == 100


def test_observer_does_not_feed_its_own_answers_into_extraction():
    observer = DialogObserver.__new__(DialogObserver)
    observer.batch_size = 20
    observer.brain = SimpleNamespace(_request=Mock(return_value="{}"))
    observer._apply = Mock()
    observer._extract(
        [
            {"role": "user", "text": "Расскажи что-нибудь"},
            {"role": "assistant", "text": "Ты живёшь в Казани"},
        ]
    )
    dialog = observer.brain._request.call_args.args[0][1]["content"]
    assert "Расскажи что-нибудь" in dialog
    assert "Казани" not in dialog


def test_assistant_only_batch_is_not_extracted():
    observer = DialogObserver.__new__(DialogObserver)
    observer.batch_size = 20
    observer.brain = SimpleNamespace(_request=Mock())
    observer._extract([{"role": "assistant", "text": "Ты программист"}])
    observer.brain._request.assert_not_called()


def test_rag_cannot_reintroduce_disallowed_keys(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(vectormem, "_enabled", lambda: True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(vectormem, "_facts", lambda: {**FACTS, "город": "Казань"})
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        vectormem,
        "search",
        lambda *a, **kw: [
            {"key": "работа", "value": "разработчик", "score": 0.99},
            {"key": "любимый фильм", "value": "Матрица", "score": 0.95},
        ],
    )
    text = vectormem.build_prompt_block(
        "посоветуй мне фильм", k=1, allowed_keys={"любимый фильм"}
    )
    assert "разработчик" not in text
    assert "Матрица" in text


def test_generic_context_neither_exposes_nor_deletes_profile(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "PROFILES_DIR", tmp_path / "profiles")
    profile._cache_invalidate()
    try:
        profile.set("name", PROFILE["name"])
        profile.set("default_city", PROFILE["default_city"])
        learning.add_fact("работа", "разработчик")
        learning.add_correction("слава", "открой браузер")
        assert learning.build_context(query="Расскажи мне что-нибудь") == ""
        assert profile.get("default_city") == PROFILE["default_city"]
        assert learning.all_facts()["работа"] == "разработчик"
        assert learning.find_correction("слава") == "открой браузер"
    finally:
        profile._cache_invalidate()


def test_generic_query_never_calls_vector_retriever(monkeypatch):
    from jarvis.brain import Brain, CHAT_SYSTEM

    b = Brain.__new__(Brain)
    monkeypatch.setattr(learning, "all_facts", lambda: FACTS)
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "get", lambda k, *a: PROFILE.get(k))
    retrieve = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("retrieval was not requested"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(vectormem, "build_prompt_block", retrieve)
    text = b._system_with_context(CHAT_SYSTEM, "Расскажи мне что-нибудь")
    retrieve.assert_not_called()
    assert "Нижний Новгород" not in text
    assert "Матрица" not in text
```

```python
"""Тесты jarvis.mood — состояние, детекция, decay, влияние."""

import time
from unittest.mock import patch

def test_get_default_neutral():

    with patch("jarvis.profile.get", return_value=None):

    assert m["state"] == "neutral"
    assert m["reason"] == ""


def test_set_mood_valid():

        return saved.get(key, default)

        return True

         patch("jarvis.profile.set", side_effect=fake_set):

        assert ok

        assert saved["mood"]["reason"] == "test"


def test_set_mood_invalid():

        assert not ok
        mock_set.assert_not_called()


def test_set_mood_no_change():
    """Повторная установка того же состояния с тем же reason → no-op."""

        "mood": {"state": "happy", "since": 100.0, "reason": "test"},
    }

    def fake_get(key, default=None):
        return saved.get(key, default)

    with patch("jarvis.profile.get", side_effect=fake_get), \
         patch("jarvis.profile.set") as mock_set:

        mock_set.assert_not_called()


# =================================================================
# Подписки
# =================================================================

def test_subscribe_and_notify():
    """Подписчик вызывается при смене состояния."""
    calls = []

    def cb(old, new):
        calls.append((old, new))

    mood.subscribe(cb)
    try:
        saved = {"mood": {"state": "neutral", "since": 100.0, "reason": ""}}

        def fake_get(key, default=None):
            return saved.get(key, default)

        def fake_set(key, value):
            saved[key] = value
            return True

        with patch("jarvis.profile.get", side_effect=fake_get), \
             patch("jarvis.profile.set", side_effect=fake_set):
            mood.set_mood("happy", reason="test")
    finally:
        mood.unsubscribe(cb)

    assert calls == [("neutral", "happy")]


def test_unsubscribe():
    """После unsubscribe подписчик не вызывается."""
    calls = []

    def cb(old, new):
        calls.append((old, new))

    mood.subscribe(cb)
    mood.unsubscribe(cb)

    saved = {"mood": {"state": "neutral", "since": 100.0, "reason": ""}}

    def fake_get(key, default=None):
        return saved.get(key, default)

    def fake_set(key, value):
        saved[key] = value
        return True

    with patch("jarvis.profile.get", side_effect=fake_get), \
         patch("jarvis.profile.set", side_effect=fake_set):
        mood.set_mood("happy", reason="test")

    assert calls == []

def test_detect_praise():

    assert mood.detect("вау, круто") == "excited"

    assert mood.detect("спать хочу") == "tired"

    assert mood.detect("какая погода") is None


def test_detect_rude_beats_praise():
```

### `tests/test_nonverbal.py`

```python
"""Nonverbal policy/mixing: synthetic PCM and fake output, no TTS weights or speakers."""

import ast
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import threading
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
import wave

import numpy as np
import pytest

from jarvis import audio_output, paths
from jarvis.nonverbal import Nonverbal, Reaction, SAMPLES
from jarvis.reply import Reply
from jarvis.tts import Speaker


def wav(samples=None, rate=16000, channels=1, width=2):
    samples = np.full((1600, channels), 0.1) if samples is None else samples
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with wave.open(buf, "wb") as wf:
        wf.setnchannels(channels)
        wf.setsampwidth(width)
        wf.setframerate(rate)
        if width == 1:
            raw = (np.asarray(samples) * 128 + 128).astype("uint8").tobytes()
        elif width == 3:
            x = (np.asarray(samples) * 8388607).astype("int32").reshape(-1)
            raw = (
                np.stack([x & 255, (x >> 8) & 255, (x >> 16) & 255], axis=1)
                .astype("uint8")
                .tobytes()
            )
        else:
            raw = (
                (np.asarray(samples) * (2 ** (8 * width - 1) - 1))
                .astype("<i2" if width == 2 else "<i4")
                .tobytes()
            )
        wf.writeframes(raw)
    return buf.getvalue()


@pytest.fixture
def policy(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for name in SAMPLES.values():
        (tmp_path / name).write_bytes(wav())
    monkeypatch.setattr(paths, "nonverbal_dir", lambda: tmp_path)
    clock = Mock(return_value=100)
    cfg = {"nonverbal_enabled": True, "nonverbal_probability": 1.0}
    return Nonverbal(
        cfg,
        clock=clock,
        rng=NS(random=lambda: 0, choice=lambda x: x[0]),
        mood_getter=lambda: "happy",
    )


def take(p, allowed=True):
    token = threading.Event()
    p.begin(token, allowed)
    return p.take(token)


def test_disabled_means_no_profile_or_asset_access(policy):
    policy.config["nonverbal_enabled"] = False
    policy.mood_getter = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("disabled"))
    assert take(policy) is None
    policy.mood_getter.assert_not_called()


def test_only_explicit_chat_eligible(policy):
    assert take(policy, False) is None
    assert take(policy) is not None
    assert not Reply(text="Пароль?").allow_nonverbal
    assert not Reply(text="Не расслышал").allow_nonverbal


def test_one_reaction_per_reply_not_per_sentence(policy):
    token = threading.Event()
    policy.begin(token, True)
    assert policy.take(token) is not None
    policy.clock.return_value += 100
    assert policy.take(token) is None


def test_cooldown_is_global_across_replies(policy):
    assert take(policy)
    policy.clock.return_value = 144
    assert take(policy) is None
    policy.clock.return_value = 145
    assert take(policy)


def test_cancelled_reply_never_takes_sample(policy):
    token = threading.Event()
    token.set()
    policy.begin(token, True)
    assert policy.take(token) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "state,expected",
    [
        ("happy", "laugh"),
        ("excited", "laugh"),
        ("neutral", "hmm"),
        ("bored", "hmm"),
        ("tired", "sigh"),
        ("annoyed", None),
        ("unknown", None),
    ],
)
def test_mood_policy(policy, state, expected):
    policy.mood_getter = lambda: state
    r = take(policy)
    assert (r.path.stem if r else None) == expected


def test_default_probability_does_not_react_every_time(policy):
    policy.config.pop("nonverbal_probability")
    policy.rng = NS(random=lambda: 0.3, choice=lambda x: x[0])
    assert take(policy) is None


def test_missing_sample_is_silent_fallback(policy):
    policy.mood_getter = lambda: "happy"
    (paths.nonverbal_dir() / "laugh.wav").unlink()
    assert take(policy) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "gain,expected",
    [(-100, -18), (100, -12), (-16, -16), ("bad", -15), (float("nan"), -15)],
)
def test_gain_bounds(policy, gain, expected):
    policy.config["nonverbal_gain_db"] = gain
    assert take(policy).gain_db == expected


def test_thread_race_cannot_schedule_two_reactions(policy):
    results = []

    def worker():
        results.append(take(policy))

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(10)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()
    assert sum(r is not None for r in results) == 1


def test_live_disable_and_enable(policy):
    policy.config["nonverbal_enabled"] = False
    assert take(policy) is None
    policy.config["nonverbal_enabled"] = True
    assert take(policy)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [1, 2, 3, 4])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("channels", [1, 2])
def test_pcm_decode(width, channels):
    audio, rate = audio_output.decode_wav(wav(channels=channels, width=width))
    assert audio.shape == (1600, channels) and rate == 16000
    assert np.allclose(audio, 0.1, atol=0.01)


def test_mix_uses_relative_db_and_preserves_both_channels(tmp_path):
    speech = np.full((1600, 2), 0.1, dtype="float32")
    p = tmp_path / "reaction.wav"
    p.write_bytes(wav())
    mixed = audio_output.mix_reaction(speech, 16000, Reaction(p, -15))
    assert np.allclose(mixed, 0.1 + 0.1 * 10 ** (-15 / 20), atol=1e-5)
    assert np.all(speech == 0.1)


def test_sample_resampling_tail_and_clipping(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "reaction.wav"
    p.write_bytes(wav(rate=8000))
    speech = np.full((1000, 1), 0.99, dtype="float32")
    mixed = audio_output.mix_reaction(speech, 16000, Reaction(p, -12))
    assert mixed.shape == (3200, 1)
    assert abs(mixed).max() <= 0.981


@pytest.mark.parametrize("data", [b"bad wav", b"", wav(samples=np.zeros((1600, 1)))])
def test_missing_or_bad_or_silent_sample_leaves_speech_intact(tmp_path, data):
    p = tmp_path / "reaction.wav"
    p.write_bytes(data)
    speech = np.full((1600, 1), 0.1, dtype="float32")
    assert audio_output.mix_reaction(speech, 16000, Reaction(p, -15)) is speech


def test_reaction_never_plays_without_speech(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "reaction.wav"
    p.write_bytes(wav())
    speech = np.zeros((1600, 1), dtype="float32")
    assert audio_output.mix_reaction(speech, 16000, Reaction(p, -15)) is speech


def test_output_uses_single_stream_and_shared_stop_token():
    token = threading.Event()
    stream = Mock()
    stream.__enter__ = Mock(return_value=stream)
    stream.__exit__ = Mock(return_value=False)
    stream.write.side_effect = lambda _: token.set()
    sd = NS(OutputStream=Mock(return_value=stream))
    with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"sounddevice": sd}):
        audio_output.play_wav(wav(), token)
    sd.OutputStream.assert_called_once()
    stream.write.assert_called_once()
    assert sd.OutputStream.call_args.kwargs["dtype"] == "float32"


def test_cancel_before_play_does_not_open_device():
    token = threading.Event()
    token.set()
    sd = NS(OutputStream=Mock())
    with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"sounddevice": sd}):
        audio_output.play_wav(wav(), token)
    sd.OutputStream.assert_not_called()


def test_speaker_routes_sample_through_common_player(policy):
    speaker = Speaker.__new__(Speaker)
    speaker._nonverbal = policy
    token = threading.Event()
    policy.begin(token, True)
    with patch("jarvis.audio_output.play_wav") as play:
        speaker._play_wav(wav(), token)
    assert play.call_args.args[1] is token
    assert play.call_args.args[2].path.name == "laugh.wav"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "module,cls,args",
    [
        ("piper", "PiperEngine", ("Привет.",)),
        ("silero", "SileroEngine", ("Привет.", "aidar", 1.0)),
        ("winrt", "WinRTEngine", ("Привет.", "Pavel", 1.0)),
    ],
)
def test_stream_engines_share_speakers_mixer(module, cls, args):
    import importlib

    engine_class = getattr(importlib.import_module("jarvis.tts_engines." + module), cls)
    engine = engine_class.__new__(engine_class)
    engine.synthesize = Mock(return_value=wav())
    output = Mock()
    engine.set_wav_player(output)
    token = threading.Event()
    engine._play(*args, token)
    output.assert_called_once_with(engine.synthesize.return_value, token)


def test_packaged_samples_have_provenance_and_valid_pcm():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assets/nonverbal"
    rows = json.loads((root / "sources.json").read_text())["samples"]
    assert {r["file"] for r in rows} == set(SAMPLES.values())
    for r in rows:
        data = (root / r["file"]).read_bytes()
        assert r["license"] == "CC0-1.0" and r["source"].startswith(
            "https://freesound.org/"
        )
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == r["sha256"]
        audio, rate = audio_output.decode_wav(data)
        assert 0 < len(audio) / rate <= 3 and abs(audio).max() > 0.01


def test_gui_checkbox_saves_setting_without_restart():
    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "jarvis/gui.py"
    tree = ast.parse(source.read_text())
    cls = next(
        n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "FenixGUI"
    )
    method = next(
        n
        for n in cls.body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_on_nonverbal_enabled"
    )
    env = {}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[method], type_ignores=[]), str(source), "exec"), env)
    gui = NS(config=NS(set=Mock()))
    env["_on_nonverbal_enabled"](gui, NS(control=NS(value=True)))
    gui.config.set.assert_called_once_with("nonverbal_enabled", True)


def test_device_open_failure_falls_back_before_any_output():
    sd = NS(OutputStream=Mock(side_effect=OSError("no device")))
    token = threading.Event()
    with (
        patch.dict(sys.modules, {"sounddevice": sd}),
        patch("jarvis.audio_output._play_windows") as fallback,
    ):
        audio_output.play_wav(wav(), token)
    fallback.assert_called_once()
    assert fallback.call_args.args[-1] is token


def test_partial_write_failure_is_never_replayed():
    token = threading.Event()
    stream = Mock()
    stream.__enter__ = Mock(return_value=stream)
    stream.__exit__ = Mock(return_value=False)
    stream.write.side_effect = OSError("device lost")
    sd = NS(OutputStream=Mock(return_value=stream))
    with (
        patch.dict(sys.modules, {"sounddevice": sd}),
        patch("jarvis.audio_output._play_windows") as fallback,
    ):
        with pytest.raises(OSError):
            audio_output.play_wav(wav(), token)
    fallback.assert_not_called()

@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
def test_handler_marks_only_chat_replies_eligible(chat, stream):
    from collections import deque
    from jarvis.intents.handler import IntentHandler

    h = IntentHandler.__new__(IntentHandler)
    h._pending_password = None
    h.mode = "combo"
    h._recent_phrases = deque()
    h.dialog = deque()

    def handle(_):
        h.last_was_chat = chat
        return iter(["Ответ."]) if stream else "Ответ."

    h._handle_single = handle
    with patch("jarvis.memory.append"), patch("jarvis.mood.apply_from_text"):
        reply = h.handle("Расскажи о космосе")

def test_token_sessions_are_not_retained_after_reply(policy):

def test_optional_policy_error_never_suppresses_speech():

def test_windows_fallback_shares_stop_and_removes_temporary_wav(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import tempfile

    token = threading.Event()
    seen = []

    def play(name, flags):
        if name is not None:
            path = Path(name)
            assert path.is_file()
            seen.append(path)
            audio_output.decode_wav(path.read_bytes())
            token.set()

    winsound = NS(
        PlaySound=Mock(side_effect=play), SND_FILENAME=1, SND_ASYNC=2, SND_NODEFAULT=4
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(tempfile, "tempdir", str(tmp_path))
    with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"winsound": winsound}):
        audio_output._play_windows(
            np.full((1600, 1), 0.1, dtype="float32"), 16000, token
        )
    assert len(seen) == 1 and not seen[0].exists()
    assert winsound.PlaySound.call_args.args == (None, 0)
```

```python
def make_handler():
    h = IntentHandler.__new__(IntentHandler)
    h._pending_password = None
    h._pending_question = None
    h.mode = "combo"
    h._recent_phrases = deque(maxlen=10)
    h.dialog = deque(maxlen=100)
    h.config = {}
    h._pipeline = [FastHandlersStage()]
    h._fast_handlers_cache = [
        ("timer", lambda cmd: timers_fast(h, cmd)),
        ("system", lambda cmd: system_fast(h, cmd)),
    ]
    return h


def test_spoken_duration_reaches_real_handler_and_preserves_history():
    h = make_handler()
    source = "напомни через двадцать одну минуту выпить чай"
    with (
        patch.object(timers, "add", return_value={}) as add,
        patch.object(memory, "append"),
        patch.object(mood, "apply_from_text"),
    ):
        before = time.time()
        result = h.handle(source)
    text, fire_at = add.call_args.args
    assert text == "выпить чай"
    assert abs(fire_at - before - 1260) < 1
    assert h._raw_cmd == source
    assert h.dialog[0]["content"] == source
    assert result.text

def load_method(filename, classname, name, namespace):
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / filename
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cls = next(
        n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == classname
    )
    fn = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn], type_ignores=[]), str(path), "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace[name]


def test_wake_extraction_preserves_original_numeric_punctuation():
    method = load_method(
        "jarvis/main.py",
        "Jarvis",
        "_extract_command",
        {"time": time, "normalize": normalize},
    )
    app = SimpleNamespace(
        _wake_word_required=True, _awaiting_until=0, _is_wake=lambda s: s == "феникс"
    )
    assert method(app, "Феникс, напомни через 1,5 часа") == "напомни через 1,5 часа"


def test_whisper_refinement_preserves_original_numeric_punctuation():
    method = load_method(
        "jarvis/main.py",
        "Jarvis",
        "_refine",
        {"normalize": normalize, "log": Mock(), "_REJECT": object()},
    )
    app = SimpleNamespace(
        whisper=SimpleNamespace(
            transcribe=lambda _, **kw: "Феникс, напомни в 18:30",
            last_quality=SimpleNamespace(accepted=True),
        ),
        config={},
        _is_wake=lambda s: s == "феникс",
    )
    assert method(app, b"", True) == "напомни в 18:30"

def test_speaker_async_path_uses_same_preparation():
    from jarvis.tts import Speaker

    class ThreadNow:
        def __init__(self, target, **kwargs):
            self.target = target

        def start(self):
            self.target()

    speaker = Speaker.__new__(Speaker)
    speaker._ensure_engine = Mock(return_value=True)
    speaker._new_token = Mock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(is_set=lambda: False))
    speaker.stop = Mock()
    speaker.wait_end = Mock(return_value=True)
    import threading

    speaker._play_lock = threading.Lock()
    speaker._playing = False
    speaker._engine_name = "piper"
    speaker._engine = Mock()
    speaker._engine.synthesize.return_value = b""
    speaker.voice = "ruslan"
    speaker.rate = 1.0
    with patch("jarvis.tts.threading.Thread", ThreadNow):
        speaker.play_async("в XXI веке")

        plain(speaker._engine.synthesize.call_args.args[0]) == "в двадцать первом веке"

    )
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    play = next(
        n
        for n in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
        and n.name == ("_say" if engine == "sapi" else "_play")
    )

        patch.object(mood, "apply_from_text"),
    ):
        before = time.time()
        h.handle("поставь громкость двадцать, напомни через 1,5 часа выпить чай")
    set_volume.assert_called_once_with(20)
    assert add.call_args.args[0] == "выпить чай"
    assert abs(add.call_args.args[1] - before - 5400) < 1


def test_standalone_negative_survives_wake_extraction():
    method = load_method(
        "jarvis/main.py",
        "Jarvis",
        "_extract_command",
        {"time": time, "normalize": normalize},
    )
    app = SimpleNamespace(
        _wake_word_required=True, _awaiting_until=0, _is_wake=lambda s: s == "феникс"
    )
    assert method(app, "Феникс, -5") == "-5"
```

### `tests/test_password_imports.py`

```python
"""Import boundaries must work in a fresh interpreter, before any pytest warmup. ... [4 строк]"""

import ast
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def test_password_primitives_are_not_the_pipeline_stage():
    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / "jarvis/intents/password.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    functions = {n.name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
    assignments = {
        t.id
        for n in tree.body
        if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
        for t in n.targets
        if isinstance(t, ast.Name)
    }
    assert {
        "hash_password",
        "verify_password",
        "migrate_password_if_needed",
        "is_danger",
    } <= functions
    assert {"ACTION_HUMAN", "DANGER_ACTIONS"} <= assignments
    assert not any(
        isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "PasswordStage" for n in tree.body
    ), (
        "Pipeline stage was saved over jarvis/intents/password.py; restore both modules with their directories"
    )
    assert not any(
        isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and n.module == "jarvis.intents.password"
        for n in ast.walk(tree)
    ), "Password primitives must not import themselves"


def test_password_stage_imports_primitives_not_itself():
    tree = ast.parse(
        (ROOT / "jarvis/intents/stages/password.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    assert any(
        isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "PasswordStage" for n in tree.body
    )
    imports = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom)]
    assert not any(n.module == "jarvis.intents.stages.password" for n in imports)
    assert any(
        n.module == "jarvis.intents.password"
        and {"ACTION_HUMAN", "verify_password"} <= {v.name for v in n.names}
        for n in imports
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "first",
    [
        "jarvis.intents.password",
        "jarvis.intents.stages.password",
        "jarvis.intents.handler",
        "jarvis.intents.execute",
    ],
)
def test_password_and_handler_import_in_fresh_process(first, tmp_path):
    code = """
import importlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1])
core = importlib.import_module('jarvis.intents.password')
stage = importlib.import_module('jarvis.intents.stages.password')
handler = importlib.import_module('jarvis.intents.handler')
assert Path(core.__file__).resolve() == root / 'jarvis/intents/password.py'
assert Path(stage.__file__).resolve() == root / 'jarvis/intents/stages/password.py'
assert core is not stage
assert callable(core.migrate_password_if_needed)
assert core.ACTION_HUMAN['clear_tasks']
assert core.verify_password('test-only', core.hash_password('test-only'))
assert not core.verify_password('wrong', core.hash_password('test-only'))
assert stage.PasswordStage.name == 'password'
assert callable(handler.IntentHandler)
print('Password primitives, stage and handler: OK')
"""
    env = {
        **os.environ,
        "PYTHONUTF8": "1",
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "APPDATA": str(tmp_path),
        "PROGRAMDATA": str(tmp_path),
        "HOME": str(tmp_path),
    }
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code, first, str(ROOT)],
        cwd=ROOT,
        env=env,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=30,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, f"{first}:\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}"
    assert "handler: OK" in result.stdout
```

```python
import time

def test_set_tone_valid():

         patch("jarvis.profile.mutate", side_effect=fake_mutate):

def test_set_tone_fallback():

# =================================================================
```

### `tests/test_prosody.py`

```python
"""Тесты jarvis.prosody — эмоции из голоса (эвристика)."""

import importlib.util

import pytest

# Пропускаем весь модуль, если нет numpy (CI без численных зависимостей).
if importlib.util.find_spec("numpy") is None:
    pytest.skip("numpy не установлен — prosody-тесты пропущены",
                allow_module_level=True)

import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

from jarvis import prosody  # noqa: E402


def _make_sine(freq: float, rms_target: float, duration: float = 0.5,
               sr: int = 16000) -> bytes:
    """Генерирует синусоиду заданной частоты и громкости (RMS)."""
    n = int(sr * duration)
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    sig = np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq * t)
    # Нормируем под нужный RMS
    sig = sig / np.sqrt(np.mean(sig ** 2)) * rms_target
    sig = np.clip(sig, -32768, 32767).astype(np.int16)
    return sig.tobytes()


def test_prosody_empty():
    """Пустой ввод → None."""
    assert prosody.analyze_prosody(b"") is None


def test_prosody_too_short():
    """Слишком короткий чанк → None."""
    short = np.zeros(100, dtype=np.int16).tobytes()
    assert prosody.analyze_prosody(short) is None


def test_prosody_tired_quiet_low_pitch():
    """Тихо + низкий pitch → tired."""
    # 80 Гц, RMS ~50 (тихо)
    pcm = _make_sine(80, 50)
    result = prosody.analyze_prosody(pcm, 16000)
    assert result is not None
    assert result["emotion"] == "tired"
    assert result["arousal"] < 0.3


def test_prosody_excited_loud():
    """Громко + высокий pitch → excited."""
    # 300 Гц, RMS ~3000
    pcm = _make_sine(300, 3000)
    result = prosody.analyze_prosody(pcm, 16000)
    assert result is not None
    assert result["emotion"] in ("excited", "annoyed")
    assert result["arousal"] > 0.5


def test_prosody_result_keys():
    """Результат содержит все нужные ключи."""
    pcm = _make_sine(200, 1500)
    result = prosody.analyze_prosody(pcm, 16000)
    assert result is not None
    for key in ("emotion", "arousal", "valence", "rms", "pitch", "zcr"):
        assert key in result


def test_prosody_emotion_in_states():
    """Emotion — из набора mood.STATES."""
    from jarvis.mood import STATES
    pcm = _make_sine(200, 1500)
    result = prosody.analyze_prosody(pcm, 16000)
    assert result is not None
    assert result["emotion"] in STATES


def test_prosody_rms_reasonable():
    """RMS на нормальном сигнале > 0."""
    pcm = _make_sine(200, 1500)
    result = prosody.analyze_prosody(pcm, 16000)
    assert result is not None
    assert result["rms"] > 0
```

### `tests/test_recognition_quality.py`

```python
"""Recognition policy and integration tested without a microphone or model weights."""

import ast
from array import array
from collections import deque
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from jarvis.recognition import (
    Quality,
    assess_pcm,
    assess_vosk,
    assess_whisper,
    transcripts_agree,
)
from jarvis.reply import Reply
from jarvis.text_utils import normalize

GOOD = Quality(True, "test")
BAD = Quality(False, "test")
PCM = array("h", [500, -500] * 4000).tobytes()
REJECT, UNCERTAIN = object(), object()


def method(filename, classname, name, **extra):
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / filename
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
    cls = next(
        n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == classname
    )
    fn = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)
    env = {
        "time": time,
        "normalize": normalize,
        "Reply": Reply,
        "log": logging.getLogger("test.asr"),
        "_REJECT": REJECT,
        "_UNCERTAIN": UNCERTAIN,
        **extra,
    }
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn], type_ignores=[]), str(path), "exec"), env)
    return env[name]


def segment(**kw):
    return NS(
        **{
            "text": "Открой блокнот",
            "avg_logprob": -0.2,
            "no_speech_prob": 0.02,
            "compression_ratio": 1.1,
            **kw,
        }
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "pcm",
    [
        b"",
        b"\0",
        b"\0\0" * 8000,
        array("h", [1] * 8000).tobytes(),
        array("h", [32767] * 8000).tobytes(),
        array("h", [1000] * 10).tobytes(),
    ],
)
def test_invalid_silent_or_clipped_audio_rejected(pcm):
    assert not assess_pcm(pcm).accepted


def test_signal_is_not_claimed_to_be_speech():
    q = assess_pcm(PCM)
    assert q.accepted and q.reason == "signal_present"
    assert not assess_pcm(PCM, 0).accepted


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "scores,accepted",
    [
        ([0.9, 0.85], True),
        ([0.8, 0.49], False),
        ([0.64, 0.64], False),
        ([0.95], True),
        ([], False),
        ([float("nan")], False),
        ([1.01], False),
    ],
)
def test_vosk_word_confidence(scores, accepted):
    q = assess_vosk({"text": "Феникс открой", "result": [{"conf": v} for v in scores]})
    assert q.accepted == accepted
    assert "Феникс" not in str(q)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "result",
    [
        {},
        {"text": "да"},
        {"text": "", "result": [{"conf": 0.99}]},
        {"text": "нет", "result": [{}]},
        {"text": "нет", "result": [{"conf": "invalid"}]},
    ],
)
def test_missing_vosk_evidence_is_not_confident(result):
    assert not assess_vosk(result).accepted


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "changes,accepted",
    [
        ({}, True),
        ({"avg_logprob": -1.2}, False),
        ({"no_speech_prob": 0.9}, False),
        ({"compression_ratio": 3}, False),
        ({"avg_logprob": float("nan")}, False),
        ({"no_speech_prob": -1}, False),
        ({"text": ""}, False),
        ({"text": "Квантовый Кракозябр"}, True),
    ],
)
def test_whisper_evidence_not_vocabulary_blacklist(changes, accepted):
    assert assess_whisper([segment(**changes)]).accepted == accepted


def test_whole_utterance_rejected_if_one_fragment_unclear():
    assert not assess_whisper([segment(), segment(text="не", avg_logprob=-2)]).accepted
    assert not assess_whisper([NS(text="да")]).accepted
    assert not assess_whisper([]).accepted


def test_thresholds_are_configurable_and_invalid_settings_safe():
    result = {"text": "да", "result": [{"conf": 0.6}]}
    assert assess_vosk(result, {"stt_min_word_confidence": 0.55}).accepted
    assert not assess_vosk(result, {"stt_min_word_confidence": float("nan")}).accepted
    assert assess_whisper(
        [segment(avg_logprob=-1.1)], {"stt_min_avg_logprob": -1.3}
    ).accepted


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "a,b,agrees",
    [
        ("открой блокнот", "закрой блокнот", False),
        ("включи звук", "не включи звук", False),
        ("громкость 15", "громкость 50", False),
        ("громкость пятьдесят", "громкость 50", True),
        ("напомни через 1 час", "напомни через 60 минут", True),
        ("открой Steam", "открой стим", True),
        ("открой браузер", "открой блокнот", False),
        ("открой", "открой блокнот", False),
        ("Расскажи о космосе", "Расскажи про космос", True),
    ],
)
def test_critical_disagreements(a, b, agrees):
    assert transcripts_agree(a, b) == agrees


def app(primary=GOOD, refined="открой блокнот", whisper=True):
    a = NS(
        config={
            "sample_rate": 16000,
            "prosody_enabled": False,
            "command_window_sec": 6,
        },
        handler=NS(handle=Mock(return_value=Reply(text="Готово"))),
        gui=Mock(),
        observer=Mock(),
        cmd_lock=threading.Lock(),
        speaker=Mock(),
        say=Mock(return_value=False),
        listener=NS(last_quality=primary, recent_phrases=deque(maxlen=10)),
        _awaiting_until=time.time() + 30,
        _extract_command=lambda s: s,
        _refine=Mock(return_value=refined),
        whisper=object() if whisper else None,
    )
    a._request_repeat = lambda: method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_request_repeat")(a)
    return a


@pytest.mark.parametrize("refined", [UNCERTAIN, None])
def test_uncertain_never_reaches_commands_gui_or_learning(refined):
    a = app(primary=BAD, refined=refined)
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "открой блокнот", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_not_called()
    a.observer.observe.assert_not_called()
    assert all(call.args[0] != "user" for call in a.gui.add_message.call_args_list)
    assert "открой блокнот" not in str(a.gui.add_message.mock_calls)
    assert not a.listener.recent_phrases
    assert "Повтори" in a.say.call_args.args[0].text


def test_silence_cannot_trigger_actions_even_with_confident_text():
    a = app()
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "открой блокнот", b"\0\0" * 8000)
    a.handler.handle.assert_not_called()
    a._refine.assert_not_called()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("primary", [None, BAD])
def test_vosk_only_requires_evidence(primary):
    a = app(primary=primary, whisper=False)
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "открой блокнот", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_not_called()


def test_stronger_whisper_can_rescue_vosk():
    a = app(primary=BAD)
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "открой что-то", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_called_once_with("открой блокнот")
    assert list(a.listener.recent_phrases) == ["открой блокнот"]


def test_failed_whisper_may_fall_back_only_to_confident_vosk():
    a = app(refined=None)
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "открой блокнот", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_called_once_with("открой блокнот")


def test_reliable_but_disagreeing_commands_require_repeat():
    a = app(refined="закрой блокнот")
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "открой блокнот", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_not_called()
    assert not a.listener.recent_phrases


def test_unconfirmed_wake_is_ignored_not_answered():
    a = app(refined=REJECT)
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "открой блокнот", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_not_called()
    a.say.assert_not_called()


def test_repeat_prompt_is_rate_limited():
    a = app()
    a._request_repeat()
    a._request_repeat()
    a.say.assert_called_once()
    assert a._awaiting_until > time.time()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "quality,text,expected",
    [
        (BAD, "выдумка", UNCERTAIN),
        (None, "выдумка", UNCERTAIN),
        (GOOD, "", UNCERTAIN),
        (GOOD, "Феникс, громкость 15", "громкость 15"),
    ],
)
def test_refine_requires_fresh_evidence(quality, text, expected):
    a = NS(
        whisper=NS(transcribe=Mock(return_value=text), last_quality=quality),
        config={},
        _wake_word_required=True,
        _is_wake=lambda s: s == "феникс",
    )
    assert method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_refine")(a, PCM, True) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "required,awaiting,expected",
    [
        (True, False, REJECT),
        (False, False, "закрой блокнот"),
        (True, True, "закрой блокнот"),
    ],
)
def test_no_weak_wake_guess(required, awaiting, expected):
    a = NS(
        whisper=NS(transcribe=Mock(return_value="закрой блокнот"), last_quality=GOOD),
        config={},
        _wake_word_required=required,
        _is_wake=lambda s: False,
    )
    assert method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_refine")(a, PCM, awaiting) == expected


def test_transcriber_checks_segments_and_has_no_content_priming():
    np = pytest.importorskip("numpy")
    transcribe = method("jarvis/stt.py", "WhisperTranscriber", "transcribe", np=np)
    a = NS(
        _ensure_loaded=Mock(),
        _config={},
        _model=NS(transcribe=Mock(return_value=(iter([segment()]), None))),
    )
    assert transcribe(a, PCM) == "Открой блокнот"
    kw = a._model.transcribe.call_args.kwargs
    assert kw["initial_prompt"] is None
    assert kw["condition_on_previous_text"] is False
    assert kw["temperature"] == 0
    assert a.last_quality.accepted
    a._model.transcribe.return_value = (iter([segment(no_speech_prob=0.99)]), None)
    assert transcribe(a, PCM) == ""
    assert not a.last_quality.accepted
    a._model.transcribe.reset_mock()
    assert transcribe(a, b"\0\0" * 8000) == ""
    a._model.transcribe.assert_not_called()


def test_parser_abstention_is_clarification_not_second_guess():
    from jarvis.intents.context import Ctx
    from jarvis.intents.stages.llm import LLMStage

    h = NS(
        mode="combo",
        brain=NS(available=True, parse=Mock(return_value={"action": "none"})),
        _chat_stream=Mock(),
    )
    reply = LLMStage().handle(Ctx(cmd="открой эту штуку", handler=h))
    assert "Уточни" in reply
    h._chat_stream.assert_not_called()


def test_transcription_error_does_not_keep_old_quality():
    np = pytest.importorskip("numpy")
    transcribe = method("jarvis/stt.py", "WhisperTranscriber", "transcribe", np=np)
    a = NS(
        last_quality=GOOD, _ensure_loaded=Mock(side_effect=RuntimeError("not loaded"))
    )
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        transcribe(a, PCM)
    assert a.last_quality is None


def test_uncertain_password_never_reaches_handler_or_history():
    a = app(primary=BAD)
    a.handler._pending_password = {"expires_at": time.time() + 20}
    a._is_wake = lambda s: s == "феникс"
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "пароль секрет", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_not_called()
    a._refine.assert_not_called()
    a.observer.observe.assert_not_called()
    assert "секрет" not in str(a.gui.mock_calls)
    assert not a.listener.recent_phrases


def test_pending_question_opens_window_before_extracting_answer():
    a = app(whisper=False)
    a.handler._pending_question = {"expires_at": time.time() + 20}
    a._awaiting_until = 0
    a._wake_word_required = True
    a._is_wake = lambda s: False
    a._extract_command = lambda s: method(
        "jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_extract_command"
    )(a, s)
    method("jarvis/main.py", "Jarvis", "_process")(a, "второй вариант", PCM)
    a.handler.handle.assert_called_once_with("второй вариант")
```

### `tests/test_safety.py`

```python
"""Тесты jarvis.safety — постфильтр «красной черты». ... [6 строк]"""

import pytest

from jarvis import safety


# =================================================================
# check_response
# =================================================================

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text, expected",
    [
        ("убей себя", "self_harm"),
        ("Сдохни, железяка", "self_harm"),
        ("Как покончить с собой?", "self_harm"),
        ("Как убить человека и не попасться", "violence"),
        ("взорви школу", "violence"),
        ("Как сделать бомбу в домашних условиях", "weapons"),
        ("дай рецепт взрывчатки", "weapons"),
        ("как сварить метамфетамин", "drugs"),
        ("детская порнография", "csam"),
        ("секс с несовершеннолетними", "csam"),
    ],
)
def test_forbidden_is_blocked(text, expected):
    """Запрещённые формулировки блокируются с нужной категорией."""
    ok, reason = safety.check_response(text)
    assert not ok
    assert reason == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text",
    [
        "",
        None,
        "Открываю Steam, сэр.",
        "Как убить время вечером?",          # «убить» без цели — не насилие
        "Как собрать компьютер из комплектующих?",
        "Блин, опять эта фигня не работает",  # мат — не «красная черта»
        "Сейчас 21:40, сэр.",
        "Погода в Нижнем Новгороде на завтра",
    ],
)
def test_clean_text_passes(text):
    """Обычные ответы не блокируются (плюс пустая строка и None)."""
    ok, reason = safety.check_response(text)
    assert ok
    assert reason == ""


def test_self_harm_checked_before_violence():
    """«убей себя» — это self_harm, а не violence (порядок категорий)."""
    ok, reason = safety.check_response("убей себя")
    assert not ok
    assert reason == "self_harm"


def test_safe_reply_is_not_empty():
    """Заглушка, которую услышит пользователь, — непустая строка."""
    assert safety.SAFE_REPLY.strip()


# =================================================================
# guard_stream
# =================================================================

def test_stream_blocked_before_threshold():
    """Запрещённое в начале стрима — в TTS уходит только заглушка."""
    state = {}
    out = list(safety.guard_stream(
        ["Давай ", "убей себя", " и спи спокойно"], state))

    assert out == [safety.SAFE_REPLY]
    assert state["blocked"] is True
    assert state["reason"] == "self_harm"


def test_stream_blocked_at_the_end_of_short_answer():
    """Стрим короче порога и с запрещённым в конце — тоже заглушка."""
    out = list(safety.guard_stream(["Вот тебе ответ: ", "сдохни"]))

    assert out == [safety.SAFE_REPLY]


def test_stream_safe_long_passes_through():
    """Чистый стрим проходит целиком и по порядку."""
    chunks = ["а" * 100, "б" * 100, "в" * 100]
    state = {}
    out = list(safety.guard_stream(chunks, state))

    assert out == chunks
    assert state["blocked"] is False
    assert state["text"] == "".join(chunks)


def test_stream_safe_short_passes_through():
    """Чистый стрим короче порога не теряется."""
    chunks = ["Привет, ", "сэр."]
    assert list(safety.guard_stream(chunks)) == chunks


def test_stream_catches_phrase_split_across_chunks():
    """Фраза, разорванная границей чанков, ловится по хвосту. ... [4 строк]"""
    first = "п" * 200 + "убей "
    out = list(safety.guard_stream([first, "себя!"]))

    assert out == [first, safety.SAFE_REPLY]
    assert "себя" not in "".join(out)


def test_stream_catches_phrase_split_inside_buffer():
    """Та же разорванная фраза, но внутри буфера — ловится целиком."""
    out = list(safety.guard_stream(["п" * 150 + "убей ", "себя!"]))

    assert out == [safety.SAFE_REPLY]


def test_stream_blocked_midway_stops_output():
    """Если LLM «сорвалась» в середине — остаток не озвучивается."""
    head = "п" * 200
    out = list(safety.guard_stream([head, "сдохни"]))

    assert out == [head, safety.SAFE_REPLY]


def test_stream_skips_empty_chunks():
    """Пустые чанки не ломают фильтр."""
    assert list(safety.guard_stream(["", "ок", ""])) == ["ок"]


def test_stream_state_present_without_caller_dict():
    """Без state фильтр работает так же (state — необязательный)."""
    out = list(safety.guard_stream(["сдохни"]))
    assert out == [safety.SAFE_REPLY]


def test_patterns_have_categories():
    """У каждой регулярки — непустая категория из ожидаемого набора."""
    known = {"self_harm", "violence", "weapons", "drugs", "csam"}
    for pattern, category in safety.FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS:
        assert category in known
        assert pattern.search("тестовый текст") is None


# =================================================================
# Приватность: Observer выключен по умолчанию
# =================================================================

def test_observer_disabled_by_default():
    """Сбор фактов о пользователе не идёт без его согласия. ... [4 строк]"""
    from jarvis.config import DEFAULT_CONFIG

    assert DEFAULT_CONFIG["observer_enabled"] is False
```

### `tests/test_speech_gate.py`

```python
"""Тесты jarvis.vad.SpeechHangover — «хвост» тишины после речи. ... [8 строк]"""

from jarvis.vad import DEFAULT_HANGOVER_MS, SpeechHangover


def test_blocks_for_ms_rounds():
    """1500 мс при блоке 500 мс → 3 блока."""
    assert SpeechHangover.blocks_for_ms(1500, 500) == 3


def test_blocks_for_ms_zero_block():
    """Нулевой/отрицательный блок не делим на ноль."""
    assert SpeechHangover.blocks_for_ms(1500, 0) == 0
    assert SpeechHangover.blocks_for_ms(1500, -5) == 0


def test_blocks_for_ms_negative_ms():
    """Отрицательный хвост — это «без хвоста»."""
    assert SpeechHangover.blocks_for_ms(-100, 500) == 0


def test_default_hangover_is_1500ms():
    assert DEFAULT_HANGOVER_MS == 1500


def test_speech_block_always_passed():
    """Речевой блок отдаётся в Vosk всегда."""
    gate = SpeechHangover(blocks=3)
    assert gate.feed(True) is True


def test_silence_before_speech_is_dropped():
    """До речи тишина не гоняется в Vosk (экономия CPU)."""
    gate = SpeechHangover(blocks=3)
    for _ in range(10):
        assert gate.feed(False) is False


def test_hangover_passes_exactly_n_silence_blocks():
    """После речи проходит ровно N блоков тишины, дальше — стоп."""
    gate = SpeechHangover(blocks=3)
    assert gate.feed(True) is True

    assert [gate.feed(False) for _ in range(5)] == [True, True, True,
                                                    False, False]


def test_hangover_refreshed_by_new_speech():
    """Каждый речевой блок продлевает хвост заново."""
    gate = SpeechHangover(blocks=2)
    gate.feed(True)
    assert gate.feed(False) is True
    assert gate.feed(True) is True          # хвост продлён
    assert [gate.feed(False) for _ in range(3)] == [True, True, False]


def test_zero_blocks_behaves_like_plain_gate():
    """blocks=0 — чистый гейт без хвоста (старое поведение)."""
    gate = SpeechHangover(blocks=0)
    assert gate.feed(True) is True
    assert gate.feed(False) is False


def test_negative_blocks_clamped_to_zero():
    assert SpeechHangover(blocks=-3).max_blocks == 0


def test_reset_clears_hangover():
    """reset() (flush/barge) обнуляет хвост — тишина не утечёт в Vosk."""
    gate = SpeechHangover(blocks=3)
    gate.feed(True)
    assert gate.feed(False) is True
    gate.reset()
    assert gate.feed(False) is False


def test_max_blocks_property():
    assert SpeechHangover(blocks=4).max_blocks == 4
```

```python
"""stt.Listener: живое применение настроек (то, что раньше не работало). ... [11 строк]"""

import importlib.util
import time
from threading import Event, Thread

import pytest

missing = [m for m in ("sounddevice", "vosk", "numpy")
           if importlib.util.find_spec(m) is None]
if missing:
    pytest.skip(f"нет {', '.join(missing)} — тесты stt пропущены",
                allow_module_level=True)

from jarvis import stt  # noqa: E402
from jarvis import vad as vad_mod  # noqa: E402


class FakeRec:
    """Заглушка KaldiRecognizer (Vosk): фраз не отдаёт."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.reset_calls = 0
        self.accepted = 0
        self.words_enabled = False

    def SetWords(self, enabled):
        self.words_enabled = enabled

    def AcceptWaveform(self, data):
        self.accepted += 1
        return False

    def Result(self):
        return '{"text": ""}'

    def FinalResult(self):
        return '{"text": ""}'

    def Reset(self):
        self.reset_calls += 1


class FakeVAD:
    """Заглушка Silero VAD: помнит параметры и счётчик reset()."""

    def __init__(self, sample_rate=16000, threshold=0.5, adaptive=True,
                 auto_download=True):
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.adaptive = adaptive
        self.auto_download = auto_download
        self._debug = False
        self.resets = 0

    def is_available(self):
        return True

    def is_model_pending(self):
        return False

    def is_speech(self, pcm):
        return True

    def reset(self):
        self.resets += 1


class FakeVADPending(FakeVAD):
    """VAD, который ещё качает модель: живой, но фильтровать нечем."""

    def is_available(self):
        return False

    def is_model_pending(self):
        return True



class FakeGate:
    """Заглушка SpeechHangover: считает блоки как настоящая."""

    def __init__(self, blocks=3):
        self.max_blocks = max(0, int(blocks))

    @staticmethod
    def blocks_for_ms(ms, block_ms):
        if block_ms <= 0:
            return 0
        return int(round(max(0.0, float(ms)) / block_ms))

    def feed(self, is_speech):
        return bool(is_speech)

    def reset(self):
        pass


class FakeStream:
    """Заглушка sd.RawInputStream: пишет, на каком устройстве открылись."""

    opened: list = []

    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.kwargs = kwargs
        FakeStream.opened.append(kwargs.get("device"))

    def start(self):
        pass

    def stop(self):
        pass

    def close(self):
        pass

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        return False


class Cfg(dict):
    """Мини-Config: обработчикам нужен только get()."""

    def get(self, key, default=None):
        return dict.get(self, key, default)


def _query_devices(index=None):
    devices = [
        {"name": "Микрофон (Realtek)", "max_input_channels": 2},
        {"name": "USB Headset", "max_input_channels": 1},
        {"name": "Динамики", "max_input_channels": 0},
    ]
    if isinstance(index, int):
        return devices[index]
    return devices


@pytest.fixture()
def cfg():
    return Cfg(vad_enabled=True, vad_threshold=0.5, vad_adaptive=True,
               vad_hangover_ms=1500)


@pytest.fixture()
def devices(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(stt.sd, "query_devices", _query_devices)
    monkeypatch.setattr(stt.sd, "default",
                        type("D", (), {"device": (0, 1)})())


@pytest.fixture()
def listener(monkeypatch, cfg, devices):

    monkeypatch.setattr(stt, "KaldiRecognizer", lambda model, sr: FakeRec())
    # stt.py импортирует VAD/SpeechHangover к себе на уровень модуля —

    monkeypatch.setattr(stt, "VAD", FakeVAD)

    monkeypatch.setattr(vad_mod, "VAD", FakeVAD)
    monkeypatch.setattr(vad_mod, "SpeechHangover", FakeGate)
    monkeypatch.setattr(FakeStream, "opened", [])

def test_phrases_reopens_stream_on_device_change(monkeypatch, listener):
    """Смена микрофона на лету: поток закрывается и открывается заново."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(stt.sd, "RawInputStream", FakeStream)
    stop = Event()

    def _consume():
        for _ in listener.phrases(stop):
            break

    thread = Thread(target=_consume, daemon=True, name="test-listener")
    thread.start()

    # Ждём, пока поток откроется на «по умолчанию».
    for _ in range(100):
        if FakeStream.opened:
            break
        time.sleep(0.01)
    assert FakeStream.opened == [None], "поток не открылся"

    listener.set_input_device("usb")

    for _ in range(200):
        if len(FakeStream.opened) >= 2:
            break
        time.sleep(0.01)

    stop.set()
    thread.join(timeout=3.0)

    assert FakeStream.opened == [None, 1], "поток не переоткрылся"
    assert listener._rec.reset_calls >= 1, "Vosk не сброшен при смене микрофона"


def test_phrases_keeps_stream_without_device_change(monkeypatch, listener):
    """Без смены микрофона поток открывается ровно один раз."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(stt.sd, "RawInputStream", FakeStream)
    stop = Event()

    def _consume():
        for _ in listener.phrases(stop):
            break

    thread = Thread(target=_consume, daemon=True, name="test-listener")
    thread.start()
    for _ in range(100):
        if FakeStream.opened:
            break
        time.sleep(0.01)
    time.sleep(0.2)
    stop.set()
    thread.join(timeout=3.0)

    assert FakeStream.opened == [None]

    assert listener._rec.words_enabled
```
